goal.en: Match each message to a place and an item.
goal.zh-Hans: 为每条消息配对地点和需要携带的物品。
goal.zh-Hant: 為每條訊息配對地點和需要攜帶的物品。

teaching.en: Read one message. Find the place. Then find what to bring. Do the same for the next message.
teaching.zh-Hans: 先读一条消息，找地点和要带的物品，再读下一条。
teaching.zh-Hant: 先讀一條訊息，找地點和要帶的物品，再讀下一條。

workedExample.en: Example (not scored): Sam: Come to the school. Bring a book. → Sam: school; book.
workedExample.zh-Hans: 示范（不计分）：Sam: Come to the school. Bring a book. → Sam：school；book。
workedExample.zh-Hant: 示範（不計分）：Sam: Come to the school. Bring a book. → Sam：school；book。

blocks.title: Mia
blocks.text: Hi! I am at the library after class. Please come at four. Bring your student card. We can read together. You do not need a notebook.

blocks.title: Ben
blocks.text: Hello! I am at the park after class. Please come at five. Bring some water. We can walk together. You do not need a student card.

questions.prompt: Match each message to a place.

hints.zh-Hans: 留意 at 或 in 后面的地点。
hints.zh-Hant: 留意 at 或 in 後面的地點。

hints.zh-Hans: Mia 对应 library；Ben 对应 park。
hints.zh-Hant: Mia 對應 library；Ben 對應 park。

explanation.en: Mia says “at the library”. Ben says “at the park”. Match each place to its own message.
explanation.zh-Hans: Mia 写的是“at the library”，Ben 写的是“at the park”。地点要与各自的消息对应。
explanation.zh-Hant: Mia 寫的是「at the library」，Ben 寫的是「at the park」。地點要與各自的訊息對應。

questions.prompt: Match each message to what you bring.

hints.zh-Hans: 看以 Bring 开头的句子。
hints.zh-Hant: 看以 Bring 開頭的句子。

hints.zh-Hans: Mia 对应 student card；Ben 对应 water。
hints.zh-Hant: Mia 對應 student card；Ben 對應 water。

explanation.en: Mia says “Bring your student card.” Ben says “Bring some water.” “Do not need” means you do not have to bring it.
explanation.zh-Hans: Mia 要带 student card，Ben 要带 water。do not need 表示不需要携带。
explanation.zh-Hant: Mia 要帶 student card，Ben 要帶 water。do not need 表示不需要攜帶。

blocks.title: Art club
blocks.text: Art club: Saturday at ten, in the café. Bring a pencil. Paper is on the table. New students are welcome. You do not need a student card.

blocks.title: Swim club
blocks.text: Swim club: Saturday at eleven, at the pool. Bring a towel. There is water at the pool. New students are welcome. You do not need a water bottle.

nextStep.zh-Hans: 下次先找地点，再看需要携带什么。
nextStep.zh-Hant: 下次先找地點，再看需要攜帶什麼。
nextStep.en: Next time, find the place first. Then read what to bring.
